Almost anything in bb can be changed in a single prompt. Ask for a task tracker and one appears: a panel in your sidebar, a bb tasks command, and a skill that teaches every agent to use it.

sentences.zh: bb 中的几乎所有内容都可以在单个提示中更改。

blocks.html_en: Many of bb’s own features are built with the same tools you have. The GitHub integration, agent memory, scheduled jobs, and even remote access are all plugins.

sentences.en: Many of bb’s own features are built with the same tools you have.
sentences.zh: bb 自己的许多功能都是使用您拥有的相同工具构建的。

sentences.en: The GitHub integration, agent memory, scheduled jobs, and even remote access are all plugins.
sentences.zh: GitHub 集成、代理内存、计划作业，甚至远程访问都是插件。

blocks.html_en: The same CLI your agents use is open to any program you write: a shell script, a cron job, or your own Hermes Agent or OpenClaw bot in Telegram, Signal, or Slack. Each can spawn a thread that’s waiting in your sidebar when you are.

sentences.en: The same CLI your agents use is open to any program you write: a shell script, a cron job, or your own Hermes Agent or OpenClaw bot in Telegram, Signal, or Slack.
sentences.zh: 您的代理使用的相同 CLI 对您编写的任何程序开放：shell 脚本、cron 作业或您自己的 Hermes Agent 或 Telegram、Signal 或 Slack 中的 OpenClaw 机器人。

sentences.en: Each can spawn a thread that’s waiting in your sidebar when you are.
sentences.zh: 每个线程都可以生成一个线程，当您在时，该线程正在您的侧边栏中等待。

sentences.zh: 它在您的计算机上运行，​​并在您回来时等待您。

sentences.zh: 将任务分配给适合的人，并让一个代理生成并管理另一个代理，每个代理都在自己的线程中。

blocks.html_en: Each runs on your own subscription: the provider plan you already pay for, billed by them, not bb.

sentences.zh: 每个都在您自己的订阅上运行：您已经支付的提供商计划，由他们而不是 bb 计费。

blocks.html_en: bb is MIT-licensed end to end. Fork the repo, customize the agents, tools, and UI, and deploy your own build across your whole organization. It still runs local-first on your machines, on the provider subscriptions you already pay for.

sentences.zh: 分叉存储库，自定义代理、工具和 UI，并在整个组织中部署您自己的构建。
